title: Forwarding Refs
description: Learn how to pass refs through components to their children.

data.text: **Ref forwarding** lets a component take a ref it receives and pass it down to a child component. This is useful for reusable component libraries.
By default, refs aren't passed like props. If a parent gives a ref to your component, it won't automatically reach the child DOM element.

data.text: For more control, use useImperativeHandle with forwardRef to expose specific methods to the parent.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Ref forwarding is essential for building reusable component libraries.
